content: BigWarp supports exporting/importing landmark point-pair files (plain text/CSV) via the landmark table panel, and a documented 'Big Warp Apply' batch pattern applies one saved landmark set to transform multiple images to the same target space. For adjacent sections from the same block (wBA1-3's 5 sections), an initial landmark set can be reused as a fast starting point per section (then refined), rather than placing landmarks from scratch each time.
